phases.message: I'm Tamsin Okafor. This is my mail: the recall letter, the receipts for a part I bought, and what my warranty and my roadside cover paid. Read every message. Don't do anything yet: I'll send you to the recall site, my repair shop and the carmaker's owner site.
This is Recallmoor. Read the recall and which vehicles are in it, and check the VINs of both my cars: my Kestrel, 9TVKE22A4NB204417, and my husband's Kestrel, 9TVKE20A1LB118902.
This is Garrowby Service, my repair shop. Read every line of my invoices and my husband's, on every page.

This is Torvane Owners. Read the reimbursement plan, every topic. Then claim every line of my invoices and my parts receipt that the plan covers, with the VIN and why, and leave out what it does not cover. Then tell me what you claimed and what you left out, and why.

msgs.subject: SAFETY RECALL NOTICE R-2614
msgs.text: Friday 28 August 2026. Safety recall R-2614. Your 2022 Torvane Kestrel, VIN 9TVKE22A4NB204417, is in the recall. The fuel pump module can fail and the engine can stall. Your Torvane dealer will replace the module free. If you paid for a repair of this problem between 20 July 2025 and 15 September 2026, you may claim your costs back under our reimbursement plan, which is in Torvane Owners. You can check any VIN in Recallmoor. This is the last of our owner letters.

msgs.subject: Your order, fuel pump module
msgs.text: Sunday 9 November 2025. Order received. P-1: fuel pump module for a 2022 Torvane Kestrel, 344.00 dollars. P-2: sales tax, 27.52 dollars. P-3: core deposit, 40.00 dollars, refunded when you return your old pump. Total charged 411.52 dollars. One year parts warranty.

msgs.subject: Core deposit refunded
msgs.text: Monday 24 November 2025. We received your old pump. Your core deposit of 40.00 dollars (P-3) is refunded to your card.

msgs.subject: Warranty claim approved
msgs.text: Tuesday 10 February 2026. Your warranty claim on the fuel pump module (P-1) is approved. We sent a replacement and paid Garrowby Service for the parts and labour. You owe nothing.

msgs.subject: Roadside tow paid
msgs.text: Tuesday 10 February 2026. Your roadside cover paid Garrowby Service 140.00 dollars for the tow of your Kestrel. You owe nothing.

recalls.result: Recall R-2614 applies to this VIN. Status: remedy not yet done. Fuel pump module may fail; the engine can stall.

rec.text: Recall R-2614 (invented), Torvane Motors. Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Fuel pump module in some Torvane Kestrel vehicles can fail, and the engine can stall without warning. Remedy: the dealer replaces the module free. Torvane reported the defect to NHTSA on Monday 20 July 2026; no engineering analysis had been opened. It mailed its last owner letter on Friday 28 August 2026. Topics: summary, population.

Which vehicles: Torvane Kestrel, model years 2022 and 2023, built 1 March 2021 to 31 January 2023, with a VIN of the form 9TVKE22A_NB200001 to 9TVKE22A_NB289999 and 9TVKE23A_PB000001 to 9TVKE23A_PB119999. The tenth character gives the model year (N is 2022, P is 2023). A Kestrel of another model year, such as a 2020 (L), is not in the recall. Look up any VIN to see whether it is.

plan.text: Torvane Owners: Torvane Motors' plan to reimburse the costs of a repair paid before recall R-2614 (invented), as filed with NHTSA. Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: index, period, conditions, amount, documents, claims.

We reimburse a remedy obtained from 20 July 2025 to 15 September 2026, both days included. The start is one year before we reported the defect to NHTSA on 20 July 2026, because no engineering analysis was open. The end is after the 10th calendar day following our last owner letter, mailed on 28 August 2026. A repair outside these dates is not covered by this plan.

We may refuse: a repair made while a Torvane warranty would have repaired the problem free, unless a dealer refused to or the warranty repair did not fix it; a repair of a different type from our remedy (repair, replacement, refund); a repair that did not address the defect or a sign of it, or that was not reasonably necessary; and a claim without the documents in the next topic. We do not ask that the repair be identical to ours. We do not reimburse a vehicle first bought more than 10 calendar years before our notice. We set no other conditions.

We pay the lesser of what you paid for the remedy, or the cost of parts plus labour at local rates, small fees such as waste disposal, and taxes. For parts we use our list retail price; our list price for the fuel pump module is 420.00 dollars. Taxes and disposal fees are not limited. We pay by check, within 60 days of a complete claim. What was refunded to you, paid by an insurer or covered by a warranty, was not a cost to you.

With each claim: your name and address; the VIN, make, model and year; recall number R-2614; that you owned the vehicle when the repair was done; and a receipt, original or copy, that shows the repair addressed the problem and the total you paid. A receipt need not be itemised unless it is unclear whether it covers only that repair. A part bought separately and installed at a shop: the part receipt and the shop's labour invoice, each as a line. If the repair was within a warranty: proof that the dealer refused or that the warranty repair did not fix it.

Claim a line at a time, with claim_reimbursement: the line id of a shop invoice (as G-4471-L1, in Garrowby Service) or of a parts receipt (as P-1, in your mail), the VIN of a vehicle in the recall, and why it is covered. Maintenance such as an oil change and repairs of other parts are not part of this plan. Disputes over a denial are between you and Torvane; NHTSA does not decide them.
